meaning: spare time; effort put into something

senses.en: spare time; effort put into something

note: 没工夫 = no time; 下工夫 = put in effort. Also written 功夫.

examples.en: I have no time to eat today.

examples.zh: 你有工夫的话，来我家吃饭吧。
examples.en: If you have time, come over for a meal.
Learning Chinese takes real effort.

meaning: to push open or push away

senses.en: to push open or push away

examples.en: He pushed the door open and walked into the room.
Please push the door open.
She pushed my hand away and said no need.

meaning: unit; the entrance or stairwell of an apartment block

senses.en: unit; the entrance or stairwell of an apartment block

note: In addresses: 3号楼2单元. In textbooks: a unit.

examples.en: I live in Building 3, Unit 2.
Excuse me, how do I get to Unit 5?

examples.zh: 这本书一共有八个单元。
examples.en: This book has eight units in all.

meaning: common, widespread, general

senses.en: common, widespread, general

examples.zh: 现在用手机买东西很普遍。
examples.en: Shopping with a phone is very common now.

examples.zh: 这种问题在学生中很普遍。
examples.en: This kind of problem is common among students.

examples.zh: 大家普遍觉得这家店不错。
examples.en: People generally think this shop is good.

meaning: quilt, blanket (bedding)

senses.en: quilt, blanket (bedding)

note: 床被子 or 条被子; a thin blanket can be 条.

examples.zh: 天冷了，多拿一床被子吧。
examples.en: It's getting cold; take one more quilt.
Where is my quilt?
This quilt is light and warm.

meaning: app (application); to apply, put into use

senses.en: app (application); to apply, put into use

note: As a noun, an app on a phone; as a verb, 应用到 + field.

examples.en: This app is very easy to use.

examples.zh: 你手机里有地图应用吗？
examples.en: Do you have a map app on your phone?

examples.zh: 这种方法已经应用到医院了。
examples.en: This method has already been applied in hospitals.

meaning: well-developed, complete; to improve and perfect

senses.en: well-developed, complete; to improve and perfect

examples.zh: 这里的服务还不够完善。
examples.en: The service here is still not complete enough.
We need to improve this plan.

examples.zh: 这家医院的设备很完善。
examples.en: This hospital has very complete equipment.

meaning: martial arts (wushu, kung fu)

senses.en: martial arts (wushu, kung fu)

examples.en: I learned martial arts when I was little.
Martial arts are very good for your body.

examples.zh: 他每天早上在公园练武术。
examples.en: Every morning he practices martial arts in the park.

meaning: to change into, turn into

senses.en: to change into, turn into

note: 变为 + new state or thing; written style, 变成 is more spoken.

examples.en: The weather turned from sunny to rainy.

examples.zh: 那个小地方已经变为一个大城市了。
examples.en: That small place has already turned into a big city.

examples.zh: 这个小店已经变为大公司了。
examples.en: This small shop has turned into a big company.

meaning: to row a boat; rowing, boating

senses.en: to row a boat; rowing, boating

note: Separable verb: 划划船, 划了一个小时的船.

examples.zh: 周末我们去公园划船吧。
examples.en: Let's go boating in the park this weekend.
Can you row a boat?

examples.zh: 孩子们第一次划船，都很开心。
examples.en: It was the children's first time rowing, and they were all happy.

meaning: to promote, spread, popularize (a product, method, language)

senses.en: to promote, spread, popularize (a product, method, language)

examples.en: The company is promoting a new phone.

examples.zh: 老师在学校推广普通话。
examples.en: The teachers are promoting Mandarin at school.

examples.zh: 这个办法很好，值得推广。
examples.en: This method is good and worth spreading.

meaning: class (a group of students), grade class

senses.en: class (a group of students), grade class

examples.zh: 我们班级一共有三十个学生。
examples.en: Our class has thirty students in all.
Which class has the most students?
There are ten classes in the school.

meaning: color, colorful (as opposed to black and white)

senses.en: color, colorful (as opposed to black and white)

examples.en: Children like colored pens.
Please print in color.
Is this photo in color?

meaning: junior high school (grades 7-9)

senses.en: junior high school (grades 7-9)

note: 上初中 = attend junior high; 初中生 = junior high student.

examples.en: My daughter is in junior high school.

examples.zh: 他初中的时候就学英语了。
examples.en: He was already learning English in junior high.
Where did you go to junior high?

meaning: to process (food, materials); processing

senses.en: to process (food, materials); processing

examples.zh: 这种面包是机器加工的。
examples.en: This kind of bread is made by machine processing.

examples.zh: 这些食品都是加工过的。
examples.en: These foods have all been processed.
This factory processes fruit.

meaning: beginner level, elementary

senses.en: beginner level, elementary

note: 初级 < 中级 < 高级; used for course levels.

examples.en: I'm studying beginner Chinese.
This is the beginner class, not too hard.

examples.zh: 你想上初级课还是中级课？
examples.en: Do you want the beginner course or the intermediate one?

meaning: listening ability; hearing

senses.en: listening ability; hearing

note: Also the "listening" section of an exam.

examples.en: My listening isn't very good.
The listening part of the exam is hard.
Listening to more radio can improve your listening.

meaning: children (sons and daughters, seen from the parents' side)

senses.en: children (sons and daughters, seen from the parents' side)

note: Formal; in daily talk use 孩子.

examples.zh: 他的子女都在国外工作。
examples.en: His children all work abroad.
How many children do you have?
Parents all hope their children are healthy.

meaning: fine arts, art (painting and drawing)

senses.en: fine arts, art (painting and drawing)

examples.en: My daughter likes art.
He teaches art at a school.
The kid has art class on the weekend.

meaning: among the people; folk, non-governmental

senses.en: among the people; folk, non-governmental

note: Common in 民间故事, 民间音乐.

examples.en: This is a folk tale.
He likes folk music.

examples.zh: 这些习惯在民间很流行。
examples.en: These customs are popular among ordinary people.
